pattern: とは限らない（とはかぎらない）
purpose: Reject a statement as a universal rule while allowing it in some cases.
keywords: Plain form + とは限らない
Expensive things are not necessarily good.
Effort does not always guarantee success.
It will not necessarily be sunny tomorrow too.
Reject an inference or deny a guarantee
わけではない · correct a conclusion
とは限らない · allow exceptions
formation: Plain form + とは限らない
restrictions: Often paired with 必ずしも; it leaves room for exceptions.
mistake: It does not assert that the opposite is always true.
